spl_product_data_elements: Triple Antibiotic Bacitracin zinc, Neomycin Sulfate, Polymyxin B Sulfate WHITE PETROLATUM LIGHT MINERAL OIL POLYMYXIN B SULFATE POLYMYXIN B NEOMYCIN SULFATE NEOMYCIN BACITRACIN ZINC BACITRACIN
active_ingredient: Active Ingredient Polymyxin B Sulfate 5000 Units
indications_and_usage: Uses First Aid to help prevent infection in minor: cuts scrapes burns
ask_doctor: Ask Doctor before use if you have deep or puncture wounds animal bites serious burns
do_not_use: Do Not Use in eyes over large areas of the body if you are allergic to any of the ingredients
stop_use: Stop Use and Ask Doctor if If conidition persists or gets worse You need to use longer than 1 week A rash or allergic reaction develops
dosage_and_administration: Directions Clean the affected area and dry thoroughly Apply a small amount of the product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily May be covered with a sterile bandage
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients light mineral oil and white petrolatum
storage_and_handling: Storage Information Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F).
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
